// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Интерфейс роутера — чтобы фабрика могла сообщить ему о новом токене
// ------------------------------------------------------------------------
interface ITokenRouter {
    function routeToken(address token) external returns (address);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Токен с фиксированным предложением 100 000
// ------------------------------------------------------------------------
contract FixedSupplyToken is ERC20 {
    constructor(string memory name, string memory symbol, address recipient)
        ERC20(name, symbol)
    {
        _mint(recipient, 100000 * 10 ** decimals());
    }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Фабрика — токены уходят на адрес роутера (exchangeAddress)
// ------------------------------------------------------------------------
contract TokenFactory is Ownable {
    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;

    struct TokenInfo {
        string name;
        string symbol;
        address tokenAddress;
    }

    // === Адрес роутера ===
    // Изначально может быть 0. Владелец устанавливает через setExchangeAddress,
    // когда роутер задеплоен.
    address public exchangeAddress;

    // Три стейблкоина для оплаты комиссии
    IERC20 public usdc;
    IERC20 public usdt;
    IERC20 public dai;

    // Комиссии (в минимальных единицах токена, т.е. с учётом decimals)
    uint256 public feeUsdc;
    uint256 public feeUsdt;
    uint256 public feeDai;

    // Данные о токенах
    address[] public allTokens;
    mapping(address => address[]) public userTokens;
    mapping(address => TokenInfo) public tokenInfo;
    mapping(string => bool) public usedSymbols;
    mapping(address => address) public creatorOf; // токен → создатель

    // События
    event TokenCreated(
        address indexed token,
        address indexed creator,
        address indexed exchange,
        string name,
        string symbol
    );
    event ExchangeAddressUpdated(address newExchange);
    event FeesUpdated(uint256 feeUsdc, uint256 feeUsdt, uint256 feeDai);
    event PaymentTokensUpdated(address usdc, address usdt, address dai);
    event Withdrawn(address indexed owner, address indexed token, uint256 amount);

    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Конструктор
    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    constructor(
        address _usdc,
        address _usdt,
        address _dai,
        uint256 _feeUsdc,
        uint256 _feeUsdt,
        uint256 _feeDai
    ) Ownable(msg.sender) {
        require(_usdc != address(0) && _usdt != address(0) && _dai != address(0), "Zero address");
        usdc = IERC20(_usdc);
        usdt = IERC20(_usdt);
        dai  = IERC20(_dai);
        feeUsdc = _feeUsdc;
        feeUsdt = _feeUsdt;
        feeDai  = _feeDai;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Валидация символа: только A-Z и 0-9, длина 1-10
    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    function validateSymbol(string memory symbol) internal pure {
        bytes memory b = bytes(symbol);
        require(b.length > 0 && b.length <= 10, "Symbol must be 1-10 chars");
        for (uint i = 0; i < b.length; i++) {
            uint8 c = uint8(b[i]);
            require(
                (c >= 65 && c <= 90) || (c >= 48 && c <= 57),
                "Only A-Z and 0-9 allowed"
            );
        }
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Установить/изменить адрес роутера (только владелец)
    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    function setExchangeAddress(address _exchange) external onlyOwner {
        require(_exchange != address(0), "Zero address");
        exchangeAddress = _exchange;
        emit ExchangeAddressUpdated(_exchange);
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Создание токена — саплай уходит на exchangeAddress (роутер)
    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    function createToken(
        string memory name,
        string memory symbol,
        uint8 paymentToken
    ) external returns (address) {
        require(exchangeAddress != address(0), "Exchange not set");
        require(bytes(name).length > 0 && bytes(name).length <= 32, "Name must be 1-32 chars");
        validateSymbol(symbol);
        require(!usedSymbols[symbol], "Symbol already exists");

        // Выбор платёжного токена для комиссии
        IERC20 token;
        uint256 fee;
        if (paymentToken == 0) {
            token = usdc;
            fee = feeUsdc;
        } else if (paymentToken == 1) {
            token = usdt;
            fee = feeUsdt;
        } else if (paymentToken == 2) {
            token = dai;
            fee = feeDai;
        } else {
            revert("Invalid payment token");
        }

        // Комиссия — на контракт фабрики
        token.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), fee);

        // Создаём токен — 100 000 сразу уходят на роутер
        FixedSupplyToken newToken = new FixedSupplyToken(name, symbol, exchangeAddress);
        address tokenAddress = address(newToken);

        // --- Сначала сохраняем данные (важно: creatorOf ДО вызова роутера) ---
        allTokens.push(tokenAddress);
        userTokens[msg.sender].push(tokenAddress);
        tokenInfo[tokenAddress] = TokenInfo(name, symbol, tokenAddress);
        usedSymbols[symbol] = true;
        creatorOf[tokenAddress] = msg.sender;

        // --- И только теперь сообщаем роутеру о новом токене ---
        // В ручном режиме роутер просто примет вызов и будет ждать,
        // пока юзер сам выберет vault через routeTokenToVault().
        ITokenRouter(exchangeAddress).routeToken(tokenAddress);

        emit TokenCreated(tokenAddress, msg.sender, exchangeAddress, name, symbol);
        return tokenAddress;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Просмотр
    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    function getMyTokens() external view returns (TokenInfo[] memory) {
        return getUserTokens(msg.sender);
    }

    function getMyTokenCount() external view returns (uint256) {
        return userTokens[msg.sender].length;
    }

    function getUserTokens(address user) public view returns (TokenInfo[] memory) {
        address[] memory tokens = userTokens[user];
        TokenInfo[] memory result = new TokenInfo[](tokens.length);
        for (uint i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
            result[i] = tokenInfo[tokens[i]];
        }
        return result;
    }

    function getUserTokenCount(address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return userTokens[user].length;
    }

    function getAllTokens() external view returns (address[] memory) {
        return allTokens;
    }

    function getAllTokensLength() external view returns (uint256) {
        return allTokens.length;
    }

    function getTokenInfo(address token) external view returns (TokenInfo memory) {
        require(tokenInfo[token].tokenAddress != address(0), "Token not found");
        return tokenInfo[token];
    }

    function getCollectedFees() external view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        return (
            usdc.balanceOf(address(this)),
            usdt.balanceOf(address(this)),
            dai.balanceOf(address(this))
        );
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Админ-функции
    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    function setFees(uint256 _feeUsdc, uint256 _feeUsdt, uint256 _feeDai) external onlyOwner {
        feeUsdc = _feeUsdc;
        feeUsdt = _feeUsdt;
        feeDai  = _feeDai;
        emit FeesUpdated(_feeUsdc, _feeUsdt, _feeDai);
    }

    function setPaymentTokens(address _usdc, address _usdt, address _dai) external onlyOwner {
        require(_usdc != address(0) && _usdt != address(0) && _dai != address(0), "Zero address");
        usdc = IERC20(_usdc);
        usdt = IERC20(_usdt);
        dai  = IERC20(_dai);
        emit PaymentTokensUpdated(_usdc, _usdt, _dai);
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Вывод собранных комиссий
    // --------------------------------------------------------------------
    function withdrawUsdc() external onlyOwner {
        uint256 bal = usdc.balanceOf(address(this));
        require(bal > 0, "Nothing to withdraw");
        usdc.safeTransfer(owner(), bal);
        emit Withdrawn(owner(), address(usdc), bal);
    }

    function withdrawUsdt() external onlyOwner {
        uint256 bal = usdt.balanceOf(address(this));
        require(bal > 0, "Nothing to withdraw");
        usdt.safeTransfer(owner(), bal);
        emit Withdrawn(owner(), address(usdt), bal);
    }

    function withdrawDai() external onlyOwner {
        uint256 bal = dai.balanceOf(address(this));
        require(bal > 0, "Nothing to withdraw");
        dai.safeTransfer(owner(), bal);
        emit Withdrawn(owner(), address(dai), bal);
    }

    function withdrawAll() external onlyOwner {
        uint256 balUsdc = usdc.balanceOf(address(this));
        uint256 balUsdt = usdt.balanceOf(address(this));
        uint256 balDai  = dai.balanceOf(address(this));

        if (balUsdc > 0) { usdc.safeTransfer(owner(), balUsdc); emit Withdrawn(owner(), address(usdc), balUsdc); }
        if (balUsdt > 0) { usdt.safeTransfer(owner(), balUsdt); emit Withdrawn(owner(), address(usdt), balUsdt); }
        if (balDai  > 0) { dai.safeTransfer(owner(), balDai);   emit Withdrawn(owner(), address(dai), balDai); }
    }

    function withdrawNative() external onlyOwner {
        uint256 bal = address(this).balance;
        require(bal > 0, "Nothing to withdraw");
        (bool success, ) = payable(owner()).call{value: bal}("");
        require(success, "Native withdraw failed");
        emit Withdrawn(owner(), address(0), bal);
    }
}
